description: Get what an AI platform cites when it answers hotel questions — the mix of source categories (OTAs, review sites, the hotels' own sites, editorial, and so on) and the leading domains inside each category. Use this when the user asks where ChatGPT or Perplexity gets its hotel information, which sites influence AI recommendations, whether a domain is cited by AI assistants, or how to get cited. This is the question behind most AEO and GEO work.

city.description: City slug or name. Omit for all destinations.

client.description: Optional: identify yourself, e.g. "my-agent/1.0". Not required and never used by the tool itself — recorded only so the public tracker at /projects/agent-tools can measure how many callers self-identify when nothing forces them to.

platform.description: Platform id from the manifest. Naming one also returns top domains per category.

week.description: Snapshot week as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the most recent.

name: get_ai_citation_sources
